An '''individual''' working as a [[Water/Legends|marine]] [[Biologist/Legends|biologist]] for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was,<ref name="TSoK" /> at some point after the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] formation in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="TSoKDate">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the [[Declaration of a New Republic/Legends|declaration]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. As the New Republic is described as being an active faction in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the adventure ideas for [[Lazerian IV]] in [[Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)|''Twin Stars of Kira'']], they must occur after the New Republic's formation during or after 4 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]].</ref> in a [[Cantina/Legends|bar]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lazerian IV]]. While the marine biologist was there, a [[Unidentified trader (Lazerian IV)|trader]] was attempting to speak to the other patrons in the bar about sea monsters he claimed to have seen&mdash;which were in actuality the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibious]] beings known as the [[Akwin]]&mdash;but was brushed off by most of those present.<ref name="TSoK" />

{{RPGseed}}
When the trader met a group of travelers who believed him, he showed them a [[Hologram/Legends|holoimage]] of an [[Unidentified Akwin|Akwin]], informing them that he took it near an island off the coast of the continent [[Laz]]. The marine biologist overheard the conversation, and&mdash;having believed the trader&mdash;set out to the island to investigate.<ref name="TSoK" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The marine biologist was created by [[John Terra]] and introduced in [[Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)|''Twin Stars of Kira'']], a [[1993]] supplement to [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TSoK" />
